author.name: Horace Chan
author.headline: Expert in applying AI in verification

text:
When you grow old, you start interested in history. I have been reading into early computers and chips history lately. 

When you are young, there are always some old folks who know more about history than you, especially those who experienced first hand.

When you are old, you are only one old enough in the room to tell the story, it makes knowing the history more rewarding.

Especially if you can draw analogy from history lessons to today's problem, then you are the wise man.

Now, the trillion dollars question, will the AI bubble pops like the dot com bubble?   Every time I show the young engineers the stock chart of Cisco vs Nivida, I can see their face lightening up.
